nodes.label: CLAUDE.md
nodes.rationale: Current-state reference for the repo; where docs and code disagree the code wins, and this file was more recently verified than docs/.

nodes.label: Unified server-side render pipeline
nodes.rationale: v1.8 removed the <=20-canvas client-side shortcut: small jobs pay ~10-20s more latency in exchange for one contract for webhooks, large batches and resumable uploads.

nodes.label: Access-mode invariant (dashboard vs embed parity)
nodes.rationale: Dashboard and embed must produce identical print output for the same inputs; only auth and delivery differ.

nodes.label: Embed session & order-id flow
nodes.rationale: order_id/callback_url never appear in the iframe URL: caller -> session DB -> proxy cache -> injected headers -> Django.

nodes.label: Embed proxy path+method allowlist
nodes.rationale: Fail-closed, checked before token resolution. Method half is load-bearing: proxy injects the real (possibly ops-flagged) api_key, so an embed token could PUT holidays before 2026-09-03.

nodes.label: Signed completion webhook (X-Signature HMAC)
nodes.rationale: No domain allowlist on callback_url; auth via the caller's api_key and HMAC lets them verify origin.

nodes.label: Split download archives (?content=print|mock|uploads)
nodes.rationale: Same job packaged one part per archive for callers storing mock and print separately; nothing duplicated on disk.

nodes.label: Order quantity (qty) asymmetric rule
nodes.rationale: Over qty is a hard cap both sides; under qty warns and proceeds, because a wrong caller-supplied qty must not strand a real order. Server is narrower than browser and fails open.

nodes.label: Qty cap header-trust gap (2026-09-15)
nodes.rationale: Direct API callers bypassed the X-Order-Qty header; fixed by querying EmbedSession server-side.

nodes.label: postMessage contract (pe:render_job, pe:back)
nodes.rationale: pe:back exists because an iframe shares the tab's joint session history; history.back() could navigate the parent off printo.in.

nodes.label: parentOrigin targetOrigin resolver (never '*')
nodes.rationale: Prevents unrelated outer pages eavesdropping on order_id/job_id payloads.

nodes.label: Three-stage HEIC decoding chain
nodes.rationale: heic2any (2021) fails on iOS 18 tmap gain-map images and Chrome/Firefox lack a HEIC codec, so a server pillow-heif fallback is required; ICC kept, EXIF dropped to avoid double rotation.

nodes.label: Three frame renderers drift trap
nodes.rationale: Anything drawn inside a frame exists in FabricEditor, fabric-renderer and engine.py; add to one and the others silently disagree.

nodes.label: TS<->Python parity tests
nodes.rationale: Formulas duplicated across the language boundary are pinned by shared fixtures in storage/parity-fixtures/.

nodes.label: Layouts moved to Postgres LayoutCatalogue (PR #111)
nodes.rationale: Production storage/ had diverged from git (deleted/renamed layouts); moving to Postgres ended git-pull conflicts and decoupled identity from case-sensitive filesystems.

nodes.label: Immutable layout name vs editable display_name
nodes.rationale: printo.in hardcodes name into embed URLs and its SKU mapping, so renames silently 404'd; renaming retired 2026-09-16 and display_name added.
nodes.norm_label: immutable layout name vs editable display_name

nodes.label: renamed_to alias safety net
nodes.rationale: Kept because it is the only fix for the layout renamed before renaming was retired.

nodes.label: Three-tier role model (Admin/Ops/Editor)
nodes.rationale: One PIA flag per tier (is_staff, is_ops_team, authenticated); rules centralised in lib/roles.ts so UI and gates agree.

nodes.label: Ops-tier gate lives in the internal proxy
nodes.rationale: All internal-proxy traffic presents the ops-flagged INTERNAL_API_KEY, so Django's IsOpsTeam sees one identity; only the proxy knows the human. Reverses PR #24.
nodes.norm_label: ops-tier gate lives in the internal proxy

nodes.label: Ops write via non-ops alias routes (closed 2026-09-29)
nodes.rationale: Views mounted twice; Editor tier could PUT calendar-styles/holidays via public aliases. Closed with OPS_OWNED_PATHS plus READ_ONLY http_method_names.
nodes.norm_label: ops write via non-ops alias routes (closed 2026-09-29)

nodes.label: Django admin SSO via nginx auth_request
nodes.rationale: Identity headers are HMAC-signed with a purpose-bound key from EMBED_INTERNAL_SECRET so nothing on the Docker network can mint superuser.
nodes.norm_label: django admin sso via nginx auth_request

nodes.label: NextAuth v5 + PIA credentials login
nodes.rationale: authorize() separates bad credentials from upstream outage so users don't retype passwords during a PIA incident.

nodes.label: Per-IP login rate limit (5/min, in-memory)
nodes.rationale: Single-process Map; must move to Redis if the frontend scales horizontally.

nodes.label: NextAuth cookie can't be swapped twice from JS
nodes.rationale: Re-issued HttpOnly after /api/auth/session; sign out server-side before planting another role's cookie.
nodes.norm_label: nextauth cookie can't be swapped twice from js

nodes.label: Single Celery worker draining priority+standard
nodes.rationale: Priority worker removed (no producer since v1.8); surviving worker listens to both so a priority task can't sit forever. Safety net, not QoS.

nodes.label: Celery stale DB connection hardening
nodes.rationale: CONN_MAX_AGE is enforced via request signals Celery lacks; close_old_connections on task_prerun/postrun plus CONN_HEALTH_CHECKS.

nodes.label: GC runs every 6 hours, not nightly
nodes.rationale: 02:00 UTC sweep sat just before the IST expiry wave, collecting 2% and making effective retention ~4 days; disk sawtoothed 82-93% while the sweep was healthy.
nodes.norm_label: gc runs every 6 hours, not nightly

nodes.label: GC health: stale vs failing
nodes.rationale: is_deleted count reads 0 whether or not GC ran; status recorded to storage/gc_last_run.json and failing added because staleness can't say why.

nodes.label: Orphaned export directories
nodes.rationale: Formed when killed renders never reached 'completed' and their RenderJob cascaded away; GC_ORPHAN_SWEEP armed to delete 2026-09-10.

nodes.label: Duplicate chunk-staging sweep incident
nodes.rationale: An inline sweep in garbage_collector_task under an unrelated counter name pre-empted the new module; grep the whole task before adding a sweep.

nodes.label: editor_state vs render_state ownership contract (0008)
nodes.rationale: editor_state is frontend-owned (autosave), render_state is pipeline-owned (submit); never cross the streams.

nodes.label: Single retention clock (EXPORT_RETENTION_DAYS, 0012)
nodes.rationale: Recomputing expiry at sweep time made lowering retention retroactive, deleting files already promised via webhook expires_at.

nodes.label: API audit trail (APIRequest, 0014)
nodes.rationale: Table existed but nothing wrote it, so a count of 0 falsely read as 'key never used'.

nodes.label: Jobs-per-day metric from audit trail
nodes.rationale: RenderJob rows cascade away after retention, so counting them undercounts history.

nodes.label: Autosave payload bloat P1 (base64 previews)
nodes.rationale: 37% of autosaves 400'd at the 10 MB limit; fixed by stripping data: previews, not raising the limit (OOM risk).

nodes.label: Autosave gated on restoreSettled (PR #166)
nodes.rationale: A restore GET slower than the 2s debounce let autosave PUT blank state over the saved design.

nodes.label: IndexedDB File persistence (B1)
nodes.rationale: Recovers originalFile after refresh; ids keyed by File object so a photo is stored once, reclaimed after successful autosave.

nodes.label: Never-lose-edits canvas merge by file identity
nodes.rationale: Reuse keyed by name:size:lastModified, not grid position, so re-pick/reorder keeps pans/zooms on the right page.
nodes.norm_label: never-lose-edits canvas merge by file identity

nodes.label: Add Files appends, not replaces
nodes.rationale: Native file input picks are not cumulative; feeding the raw pick to setFiles wiped earlier canvases until PR #24.

nodes.label: Per-surface render grouping (canvases_meta)
nodes.rationale: Prevents the wrong-print class where a multi-surface product prints one side's photo on another; frontend must send the real surface key.

nodes.label: Calendar holiday gate (preview matches print)
nodes.rationale: Preview drew holidays the print omitted when holidaySource.enabled was off; showInCells retired as a no-op switch.

nodes.label: Book/photobook product type (backend only)
nodes.rationale: Mirrors calendar materialize architecture; R1 customer-variable surface count is the open frontend problem.

nodes.label: Book gutter mirroring by page parity
nodes.rationale: Uniform per-page shift capped by least headroom so collage elements move together.
nodes.norm_label: book gutter mirroring by page parity

nodes.label: Server-side MediaPipe auto-orientation
nodes.rationale: Inline rather than Celery because the rotation is needed before drawing the preview; aspect heuristic is the fallback.

nodes.label: S3 calendar assets with tombstones
nodes.rationale: Deleted keys write a tombstone so seeds aren't resurrected; S3 outage raises CalendarAssetUnavailable rather than guessing 'no holidays'.

nodes.label: storage/ files git-tracked and runtime-written
nodes.rationale: Never git reset --hard or checkout -- storage/ on prod; it resurrects obsolete layouts.

nodes.label: nginx.conf single-file bind-mount inode trap
nodes.rationale: git pull replaces the inode so a running proxy keeps the old config; needs recreate, not reload. sync_proxy_config closes it.

nodes.label: entrypoint.sh ignores $@ on web path
nodes.rationale: docker-compose run backend <cmd> boots gunicorn and hangs; override --entrypoint.

nodes.label: Scalar API reference (drf-spectacular)
nodes.rationale: Views without @extend_schema are dropped; SECURITY_DEFINITIONS was a silently ignored drf-yasg setting.

nodes.label: Branch first, no commits on main
nodes.rationale: main is production and the shared checkout goes stale within minutes.
nodes.norm_label: branch first, no commits on main

nodes.label: Check in before push/PR/merge
nodes.rationale: Chaining implement->merge autonomously left the user reviewing merges rather than deciding them (PRs #41-#53).

nodes.label: graphify knowledge graph (graphify-out/)
nodes.rationale: Refresh with scripts/graphify-refresh.py; graphify update re-adds stale doc nodes and unnames communities.

nodes.norm_label: tailwind indigo overridden to printo purple

nodes.rationale: Mutating React-owned nodes desyncs the virtual DOM; innerHTML is an XSS sink.

nodes.label: Observability owned outside the repo
nodes.rationale: Grafana/Loki removed 2026-09-07; container logs die on recreation (50 MB x 3).

nodes.label: Redis durable broker vs disposable cache
nodes.rationale: Cache allkeys-lru eviction must never drop in-flight Celery messages.
nodes.norm_label: redis durable broker vs disposable cache

nodes.label: Three test harnesses (Jest, services/tests, api/tests)
nodes.rationale: services/tests stay DB-free; api/tests need real Postgres+Redis because collation/cache behaviour can't be faked.

nodes.norm_label: product editor prd — end-to-end production automation (v1.13)

nodes.label: Manual Design Preflight Checkpoint
nodes.rationale: Root cause of 1–3 h TAT: legacy system had no customer preview or automatic file/qty validation, so every order passed a fixed-capacity manual gate.

nodes.label: A1 — Customer-Facing Preview Before Checkout
nodes.rationale: Customer self-validates the print-ready preview, replacing preflight's file and quantity checks.

nodes.label: HMAC-Signed Embed Webhook Delivery
nodes.rationale: Primary delivery channel: storefront sets callback_url at session creation; signed payload lets the caller verify origin and fetch the ZIP with its api_key.

nodes.label: Direct Download Fallback (poll render-status + download ZIP)
nodes.norm_label: direct download fallback (poll render-status + download zip)

nodes.label: Split Download URLs (print / mock / uploads)
nodes.rationale: Storefronts store mock and print artefacts in separate fields; served via ?content= on one endpoint with nothing duplicated on disk; combined download_url unchanged so no caller migration.

nodes.label: Low-Resolution (Effective DPI) Detection
nodes.rationale: Replaces preflight's 'is this good enough to print' judgement; deliberately non-blocking — informs, never refuses the order.

nodes.label: CMYK Soft-Proof / ICC Pipeline (Retired v1.8)
nodes.rationale: Removed entirely in v1.8; colour is now handled invisibly by ICC→sRGB colour management on load.

nodes.label: Internal OMS Push (push_to_production_estimator_task, Retired v1.9)
nodes.rationale: Product Editor is a standalone generator; the storefront talks to OMS through its own integration, so the direct push was redundant.

nodes.label: B1 — Canvas State Persistence (editor_state + IndexedDB)
nodes.rationale: Files don't serialise to JSON, so originals are persisted to IndexedDB keyed by (orderId, fileId) and rehydrated on reload.

nodes.label: B2 — Async Image Generation Queue (Celery + Redis)
nodes.rationale: Synchronous rendering held Gunicorn threads and timed out under festival peaks; async queue decouples render from the HTTP cycle.
nodes.norm_label: b2 — async image generation queue (celery + redis)

nodes.label: API Key Bundle Leak (NEXT_PUBLIC_DIRECT_API_KEY)
nodes.rationale: Key was extractable from the client JS bundle; fixed by routing all dashboard calls through a server-side internal proxy with INTERNAL_API_KEY.

nodes.label: B3 — SKU-to-Layout Mapping (Removed 2026-09-04)
nodes.rationale: printo.in resolves SKU→layout itself and passes the layout name into the embed session; a second mapping was one more thing to drift.

nodes.label: B4 — Server-Side Upload + Render for Large Batches
nodes.rationale: Client-side Fabric render crashed low-RAM devices on 100–200 photo orders; server render runs for every submit since v1.8.
nodes.norm_label: b4 — server-side upload + render for large batches

nodes.label: ≤20-Canvas Client-Render Threshold (Removed v1.8)
nodes.rationale: Single unified server-render contract traded ~10–20 s latency on small jobs for one path handling webhooks, large batches and resumable uploads.

nodes.label: B6 — Login Flow Hardening
nodes.rationale: Users retyped passwords during PIA outages because every failure read 'Invalid credentials'; outage vs bad-credential now distinguished.

nodes.label: Login Rate Limiter → Redis (open item)
nodes.rationale: In-memory per-IP Map is per-process; must move to Redis before horizontally scaling the frontend.

nodes.label: Edge Proxy Migration Traefik → nginx 1.27 (v1.9)
nodes.rationale: Traefik acme.json bind-mount footgun produced prod 404s; nginx config is single source of truth.

nodes.label: Server-Side Auto-Orientation via MediaPipe Pose (v1.11)
nodes.rationale: Photos stored sideways in the bytes defeat the aspect heuristic; pose inference finds body-up direction.

nodes.label: Server-Side Overlay Rendering (v1.12)
nodes.rationale: Text/shape/image overlays were preview-only and silently absent from the printed file.

nodes.label: Server-Side HEIC Decode (iOS 18 gain-map)
nodes.rationale: heic2any predates the tmap gain-map format and Chrome/Firefox ship no HEIC codec.

nodes.label: API Audit Trail (migration 0014)
nodes.rationale: APIRequest existed but was never written, so a zero count read as proof a key was unused when it only proved nothing was recorded.

nodes.label: GC Staleness + Live Disk Block on Celery Monitor
nodes.rationale: Tombstones are deleted in the same pass so DB counts cannot show whether GC ran; disk read at request time because the sweep's copy is stale exactly when it matters.
nodes.norm_label: gc staleness + live disk block on celery monitor

nodes.label: Orphaned Export Directory Sweep (GC_ORPHAN_SWEEP)
nodes.rationale: The one sweep that deletes on absence of evidence, so it defaults to dry_run and requires five independent conditions.

nodes.rationale: allkeys-lru cache eviction could drop in-flight Celery messages when sharing db 0.

nodes.label: EXPORT_RETENTION_DAYS_UNDER_PRESSURE
nodes.rationale: Defaults to the same value so disk pressure cannot silently shorten retention below an expires_at already sent to a partner.

nodes.label: Stamped expires_at (migration 0012)
nodes.rationale: Expiry stamped on the row at creation rather than recomputed at sweep time, so lowering the env var is no longer retroactive. Deploy the migration before lowering it.

nodes.label: UploadedFile.order_id Linkage (migration 0011)
nodes.rationale: Autosave blanked CanvasData.image_paths every 2 s, so purge deleted rows, reported files_deleted: 0 and left photos on disk; order linkage recorded at upload time makes erasure provable.

nodes.label: Order Purge Endpoint (DELETE /api/ops/orders/<id>/purge)
nodes.rationale: Ops-only, never on the embed-proxy allowlist; hard-deletes rows and files immediately; ?force=true overrides the in-flight render guard.

nodes.label: Purge Tenant Scoping (all_tenants vs api_key)
nodes.rationale: Order ids are unique only per key; a key-scoped purge must not sweep the per-order upload folder because it would erase another tenant's photos for the same order id (it did until 2026-10-07).

nodes.label: Erasure Verification Sweep (erasure_complete / residual_files)
nodes.rationale: Re-checks every deleted path after commit and retries once, so a silently failed delete can no longer report success.

nodes.label: Never Delete by Blank order_id
nodes.rationale: order_id='' is the legitimate value for direct partner API uploads; a cleanup keyed on blank order_id destroys valid uploads.

nodes.label: Upload-Only Order Purge Fix (2026-10-07)
nodes.rationale: Orders holding only photos answered 'No data found' and kept the photos; matched counted designs only, so the endpoint 404'd orders it had erased. Pinned by api/tests/test_order_purge.py.

nodes.label: Orphan Export Sweep (GC_ORPHAN_SWEEP=delete)
nodes.rationale: The one sweep that deletes on absence of a DB row, so it shipped disarmed; armed in production 2026-09-10 behind five independent guards.

nodes.label: EmbedSession 30-Day GC Sweep
nodes.rationale: Closed 2026-09-10 (commit 56a2136); rows held order_id + callback_url and grew unbounded.

nodes.label: API Audit Trail Retention (API_AUDIT_RETENTION_DAYS=90)
nodes.rationale: Deliberately outlives the data it describes so 'who touched this order' stays answerable. Before 0014 the table was empty, which read as proof a leaked key was never used.

nodes.label: AUDIT_EXEMPT_PREFIXES (deliberate blind spots)
nodes.rationale: health/config/render-status/chunk PUTs exempt for volume (~1,500 rows/hour); any new customer-data endpoint matched by an exemption creates a silent gap in the erasure trail.

nodes.label: Calendar S3-Readiness Audit
